title: A node --test started from inside node --test skips its files
body: When code running under the node test runner spawns another `node --test` (an eval check, a proof in tests/bench), the child inherits NODE_TEST_CONTEXT from the parent and prints 'node:test run() is being called recursively within a test file. skipping running files.' It runs nothing and reports no failure, so every check that parses its output reads as failed. Remove NODE_TEST_CONTEXT from the child's environment (`const { NODE_TEST_CONTEXT, ...env } = process.env`), as src/eval/bench/projects/supermem/mined.js does.
not_derivable: The same check works when run from a plain script (the bench runner) and fails only inside node --test, with a warning on stderr rather than an error.

evidence.summary: Cited when this memory was saved.
